jobs.description:
Memorial Hermann Health System is seeking a Security Supervisor to help protect and promote safety at a hospital campus in Houston. The role requires leadership of security staff, incident response, and coordination with clinical teams to support a safe patient and staff environment.

The candidate should have at least two years of supervisory security experience, a High School Diploma or GED, and relevant Texas licenses and CPR certifications.
